snippet.title: BECROWNED ► "A Kingdom By The Sea" Trailer at Top Hat Studios Spring Showcase
snippet.description:
BECROWNED is a psychological, black comedy horror which blurs the line between medieval dark fantasy and rotting industrial horror. Players step into the shoes of Richard Torrance, a cold and rational man whose pursuit of happiness has led him into a bizarre, dark ages nightmare ruled by the seemingly absent “Omen Raven”… and where his own fears seem to creep into reality from a distant past.

Wrapped in an odd crunchy-yet-high-definition style which makes usage of wide ranging color palettes and sprawling environments, the game challenges you to explore crumbling castles, decrepit hospitals, eerie motels, ancient ruins, and more. Featuring classic survival horror elements like resource management, puzzle-solving, and challenging boss fights, BECROWNED also deeply emphasizes player freedom and boasts deep, meaningful player choice and an engaging, dynamic world filled with side stories alongside a nonlinear storyline where your choices determine the fate of others and lead to multiple, drastically different endings.

Features:
- A bizarre and surreal world which merges dark ages fantasy with modern industrial horror
- Sprawling levels which house a cast of oddball characters, hidden curiosities, and other oddities
- Nonlinear, choice-driven storyline: Your decisions truly impact the world, leading to numerous dynamic changes as you play the game
- Classic survival horror mechanics emphasize resource management, puzzle-solving, and strategic combat but with unique modernizations
- Captivating visuals and direction, employing unique cinematography and visual style
